title: Beach patrol nesting records
description: Nightly patrol counts of nesting activity, false crawls and hatchling emergence by beach. Public version is aggregated by beach and week.

title: Nest locations (GPS)
description: Individual nest coordinates from beach patrols. Withheld from the public site to protect nests.

title: Leatherback post-nesting satellite tracks
description: Satellite telemetry of leatherbacks tagged after nesting in Dominica. Held until the migration paper is published.

title: Coral restoration site temperature loggers
description: Quality-controlled in-situ temperature series from restoration site loggers (including HB05), with degree heating weeks and SST comparison.

title: BRUV deployment log
description: Baited remote underwater video deployments: site, date, depth, duration and annotation status. Video files are stored externally.

title: Southern Dominica soils and landslide hazard
description: Soil classification and landslide hazard layers for land planning in southern Dominica.

title: Cane farming program records
description: Participating farmers, acreage and harvest summaries for the cane farming program. Farmer names removed from the public version.

title: Distillery energy system data
description: Energy generation and use at Rosalie Bay Distilling.

title: Sperm whale model school visits
description: Schools visited with the life-size sperm whale model: date, school, parish and number of students reached.
